description: This file defines dependencies and utility functions related to authentication, database session management, rate limiting, idempotency, and request validation for a FastAPI backend. It includes classes, dependency injection functions, and various helpers used for securing and managing API endpoints within the LudoGameBackendFastAPI project.

classes.name: AuthContext
classes.description: Dataclass representing the authenticated request context containing the user object.

methods.name: AsyncSession _get_db_session()
methods.description: Creates a new asynchronous database session from the session factory, raising an HTTP 503 if not configured.

methods.name: AsyncSession db_session_dep()
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that yields an AsyncSession for request handling and ensures proper cleanup.

methods.name: Optional[str] _bearer_token_from_header(authorization: Optional[str])
methods.description: Extracts the Bearer token from the Authorization header string.

methods.name: str _require_setting(name: str, value: Optional[str])
methods.description: Checks if a required setting value is present; raises HTTP 503 if absent.

methods.name: str _b64url_encode(data: bytes)
methods.description: Encodes bytes into a URL-safe base64 string without padding.

methods.name: bytes _b64url_decode(data: str)
methods.description: Decodes a URL-safe base64 string into bytes, adding padding if necessary.

methods.name: bytes _jwt_sign_hs256(secret: str, signing_input: bytes)
methods.description: Creates an HMAC SHA256 signature for a given signing input with a secret key.

methods.name: str _jwt_encode(payload: dict, secret: str)
methods.description: Constructs a JWT token string from payload and secret.

methods.name: dict _jwt_decode(token: str, secret: str)
methods.description: Decodes and verifies a JWT token string using a secret, raising HTTP 401 on failure.

methods.name: str issue_access_token(*, user_id: uuid.UUID, is_guest: bool)
methods.description: Generates a signed JWT for a user, including claims like subject, issuer, audience, and expiration.

methods.name: None _validate_claims(payload: dict)
methods.description: Validates the claims in a decoded JWT payload, checking expiration, issuer, and audience.

methods.name: AuthContext auth_required( authorization: Annotated[Optional[str], Header(alias="Authorization")] = None, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)] = None, )
methods.description: FastAPI dependency that authenticates requests using Bearer JWTs and retrieves the user object.

methods.name: str _rate_limit_key(request: Request, bucket: str)
methods.description: Generates a rate limit key based on user ID or IP address.

methods.name: None rate_limit(request: Request, *, bucket: str, limit: int, window_seconds: int)
methods.description: Implements fixed-window rate limiting using Redis, with fallback behavior if Redis is unavailable.

methods.name: str _idem_cache_key(*, namespace: str, key: str, user_id: uuid.UUID)
methods.description: Constructs a unique idempotency cache key from namespace, user ID, and key.

methods.name: Optional[dict] idempotency_guard( request: Request, *, namespace: str, user_id: uuid.UUID, idempotency_key: Optional[str], ttl_seconds: int = 24 * 3600, )
methods.description: Checks for previous requests with the same idempotency key, returning stored response if available or establishing a placeholder.

methods.name: None idempotency_store_response( *, namespace: str, user_id: uuid.UUID, idempotency_key: Optional[str], response_json: dict, ttl_seconds: int = 24 * 3600, )
methods.description: Stores the response data for an idempotent request in Redis.

methods.name: Optional[str] idempotency_key_header( idempotency_key: Annotated[Optional[str], Header(alias=_IDEMPOTENCY_HEADER)] = None, )
methods.description: FastAPI dependency to retrieve the Idempotency-Key header value.

methods.name: None ensure_profile_exists( auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)], )
methods.description: Ensures a profile record exists for the authenticated user, creating it if necessary (best-effort).

ctags.name: _idem_cache_key
ctags.pattern: /^def _idem_cache_key(*, namespace: str, key: str, user_id: uuid.UUID) -> str:$/
ctags.signature: (*, namespace: str, key: str, user_id: uuid.UUID)

ctags.name: auth_required
ctags.signature: ( authorization: Annotated[Optional[str], Header(alias="Authorization")] = None, session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)] = None, )

ctags.name: ensure_profile_exists
ctags.signature: ( auth: Annotated[AuthContext, Depends(auth_required)], session: Annotated[AsyncSession, Depends(db_session_dep)], )

ctags.name: idempotency_guard
ctags.signature: ( request: Request, *, namespace: str, user_id: uuid.UUID, idempotency_key: Optional[str], ttl_seconds: int = 24 * 3600, )

ctags.name: idempotency_store_response
ctags.signature: ( *, namespace: str, user_id: uuid.UUID, idempotency_key: Optional[str], response_json: dict, ttl_seconds: int = 24 * 3600, )

ctags.name: issue_access_token
ctags.pattern: /^def issue_access_token(*, user_id: uuid.UUID, is_guest: bool) -> str:$/

ctags.name: rate_limit
ctags.pattern: /^async def rate_limit(request: Request, *, bucket: str, limit: int, window_seconds: int) -> None:$/
ctags.signature: (request: Request, *, bucket: str, limit: int, window_seconds: int)
